description: This file provides PHP4 session management using the ADODB database wrapper library, including functions for session handling, database connection, and session garbage collection.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: Class managing the database connection for session storage.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID and updates it in the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Creates or reuses a database connection for session storage.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session from the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of expired sessions.
